title: Cranks 'n' Canyons
description: just another kitchen sink Create modpack for me, my friends, and everyone else that are interested.
body:
#### just another kitchen sink Create modpack for me, my friends, and everyone else that are interested.

## Some Mods
Performance mods such as **Sodium**, **Lithium**, **ImmediatelyFast**, **FerriteCore**, and more.

**Create** and many of its add-ons such as **Aeronautics**, **Big Cannons**, **Power Grid**, **Northstar**, and more.

Harder (and annoying) survival mechanics using **Cold Sweat**, **Thirst was Taken**, **Primity**, **HT's TreeChop**, **EnhancedAI**, **Weather2**, and more.

Expanded vanilla equipments using **Better Weaponry**, **Fantasy Armor**, **Epic Knights**, and more.

Some client-side mods such as **AppleSkin**, **Cubes With Borders**, **EMI**, **Jade**, **Nemo's Inventory Sorting**, and more.

**William Wyther's Overhauled Overworld** + datapacks and **Continents** mod for better world generation.

## Notable Mods
- Sodium and Iris
- Create
- Create Aeronautics
- vista
- Physics Mod Pro (u can change anything but i suggest keeping ocean physics on)
- Antique Atlas 4 (try your best using no minimaps)
- Distant Horizons
- ParCool (will not work on aeronautics sublevels)
- Punchy
- Simple Voice Chat
- Cold Sweat + Thirst was Taken + Ecliptic Seasons + Primity + Weather2
- Better Combat
- Alex's Mobs
- The Roads More Travelled (works thanks to sinytra)

## Temporarily Disabled Mods
- Auto Third Person (may get removed in future versions)
- First Person (may get removed in future versions)
- Quality of Queso (new, still feeling it out)
- Create Frequency (latest version does not work on dedicated servers, but can work on singleplayer)

---

I have many plans to make this modpack actually good, so bear with me.

---

Keybinds are configured based on my personal preference so feel free to check if you'd like to use it or not. There are also pre-installed shaders, data packs, and resource packs that you may or may not try.

---

## Be Careful
On future versions, some mods may get removed or replaced by other mods because I still plan to modify and configure all the mods so they all fit. So, your saves/worlds will inevitably break when you update to newer versions. Apologies, immediately.
